- Legend is a science fiction Western television series that aired on UPN from April 18, 1995, until August 22, 1995.
- Legend had one final re-airing of its pilot on July 3, 1996.
- Legend starred Richard Dean Anderson and John de Lancie.
- Jonathan de Lancie was born on March 20, 1948.
- Jonathan de Lancie is an American stand-up comedian, actor, director, producer, writer, singer, musician, and voice artist.
- John de Lancie is best known for playing Q in Star Trek television series from 1987 to 2001 and for voicing a character in My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic from 2010 onward.
